home.title: Welcome to Dokko Filler
home.description: This platform lets you generate contracts quickly and easily. Create and review contracts in one place, with maximum efficiency and an intuitive experience.

choose.title: Choose a contract
choose.text: Pick a template from the list of available contracts.

load.title: Load the documents
load.text: Insert an ID card or vehicle registration card into the reader and the data fills in by itself.

download.title: Review and download
download.text: Check how the document looks and download the finished .docx file.

about.title: About Dokko
about.purpose: This platform generates contracts automatically. The goal of the app is to make filling in various types of contracts faster and simpler, which saves time and makes work more efficient.
about.goal: Our goal is to improve your productivity and offer an experience that is intuitive and pleasant.

demo.title: Contracts
demo.subtitle: A demo list of contracts with prepared data. Choose a contract to run the whole process without logging in or loading documents.

intro.title: Welcome to Dokko Filler
intro.content: In a minute we will show you where everything is. You can skip the tour and start it later from the user menu.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.content: All contract templates are here. Choose a contract, load ID cards and vehicle registration cards from the reader, and the app fills in the contract.

demo.title: Demo
demo.content: Try the whole process with made-up data, without a card reader.

language.title: Language
language.content: Switch the app to Serbian or back to English. Filled-in contracts stay in the language of the template.

theme.title: Light and dark theme
theme.content: Pick the theme you prefer; the app remembers it.

userMenu.title: Your account
userMenu.content: Log out here, or start this tour again.

done.title: You are ready
done.content: The fastest way to learn the app is to go through the demo once: it takes about a minute.

intro.title: Demo mode
intro.content: Everything here works like the real app, but the data is made up. No card reader or login is needed.

contract.title: Choose a contract
contract.content: Every contract is a Word template with fields that fill in by themselves. Click the contract to start.

cards.title: Load the documents
cards.content: In real use you insert the card into the reader and click the slot. Here a click loads made-up data right away. Remove a card loaded by mistake with the bin icon.

progress.title: Progress
progress.content: Here you see how many of the required documents are loaded.

preview.title: Preview and download
preview.content: Once all documents are loaded, open the preview: filled fields are highlighted, and you can print the contract or download it as .docx.

done.title: That is the whole process
done.content: Load all three documents and open the preview. Then try it with your own contracts and real documents.

contract.title: Choose a contract
contract.content: Click the contract you want to fill in. The screen for loading documents opens.

reader.title: Get the reader ready
reader.content: Before loading, start the card reader program on this computer and plug in the reader. Data is read directly from the chip of the ID card and vehicle registration card.

cards.title: Load the documents
cards.content: Insert the card into the reader and click the slot for that document. Check the loaded data; remove a card loaded by mistake with the bin icon.

progress.title: Progress
progress.content: Here you see how many of the required documents are loaded.

preview.title: Preview and download
preview.content: Once all documents are loaded, open the preview. The fields the app filled in are highlighted.

done.title: You are ready
done.content: If the reader does not respond, check that the reader program is running and the card is inserted correctly.

zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.content: Zoom the page in or out, or fit it to the width of the screen.

highlight.title: Highlighted fields
highlight.content: Values the app entered are highlighted in yellow so you can check them easily. The highlight is not part of the downloaded document.

download.title: Download the contract
download.content: Download the contract as .docx and open it in Word, or print it right away.
